name: Chowgule Steamships Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1963, Chowgule Steamships Ltd is engaged in carriage of goods by sea
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company owns and operates one vessel for seaborne transportation of bulk cargo

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 4.30% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.94 Cr.
Working capital days have increased from 341 days to 763 days
